settings.heading: WHATS SO SPECIAL ABOUT THESE SOCKS?
settings.content:
Koala Conservation Australia are best known for Their world-famous Koala Hospital, which rescues and rehabilitates sick and injured koalas.

When you purchase our Wombat Sock, 10% of proceeds are donated to KCA.

More About The Koala Hospital:
The Port Macquarie Koala Hospital was established in 1973 as Australia’s first dedicated Koala Hospital and licensed wildlife rehabilitation facility.

Since then, They have rescued, treated and released thousands of koalas, and the Hospital has evolved into a leading koala training, research and education centre. 

In 2024 they lauched their Koala Conservation Wild Breeding Program. A potential game changer for the future of the species.

As well as completing a a new state-of-the-art breeding, clinical and research facility, alongside a visitor education centre, near Port Macquarie in the Cowarra State Forest. Called 'Guulabaa - Place of Koala'.

settings.heading: How do i care for novelty socks?
settings.row_content:
• Washing: Machine wash your socks in cold water with similar colours. This helps prevent colour bleeding and maintains the vibrancy of your socks.

  • Avoid Bleach: Do not use bleach or harsh detergents, as they can damage the fibers and colours of the socks.

  • Drying: For longevity, line dry your socks. If you prefer machine drying, use a cold/low heat setting. High heat can cause shrinkage and affect the elasticity of the sock.
